channel.title: wrnty Blog
channel.description: Practical advice on warranties, receipts and buying smart — from the team behind wrnty.

item.title: What counts as proof of purchase — and what to do without a receipt
item.description: The receipt is only one form of proof of purchase. Here's what companies accept, what they won't, and how to rebuild your proof when the receipt is gone.

item.title: How to make a warranty claim (and what to do when it's refused)
item.description: A practical guide to making a warranty claim — what you need, how to do it, and what to do when the manufacturer says no.

item.title: How long is the warranty on common things — a plain reference
item.description: A plain-English guide to the warranty length on phones, laptops, appliances, cars, tyres, mattresses and more — plus what statutory rights add on top.

item.title: How to keep track of warranties without a drawer full of receipts
item.description: A simple, repeatable system for tracking product warranties so you never miss a claim — and can find any receipt in seconds.

item.title: Is an extended warranty worth it? A simple way to decide
item.description: Extended warranties are hugely profitable for the seller — but sometimes worth it for you. Here's a clear way to decide at the till.
